title: Feeds and doses per day as a bricks bar or stacked bar chart
goal: The owner sees what each pump gave per day at a glance
acceptance: The plant or room page shows mL per nutrient per day (stacked bar) from the feed history the hub already serves
Empty state when there are no feeds; e2e checks the chart and its table
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Data exists (/api/feeds); one chart. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
